related_questions.question: What is the new capital gains tax in the UK?
related_questions.snippet: What changes to the tax were made in the 2024 Autumn Budget? In her Budget statement on 30 October 2024, the Chancellor, Rachel Reeves, announced increases in both the lower rate of CGT (from 10% to 18%) and the higher rate of CGT (from 20% to 24%). These rate increases took immediate effect.
